name: Keynote stage screen
oneLiner: a dark auditorium, a giant stage screen flickers on with the brand's real screen and floods the hall with its own light: haze glows, the rows of a real silhouetted crowd catch a rim of the screen's colour, the camera dollies in slowly and the slide cuts once to the next screen like a live keynote
say: when the speaker frames something as a big launch or a reveal ('this is the moment it went public', 'imagine showing this on stage'): cut in on the build-up, the screen powers on on the word that names it, the slide cuts on the next beat. Set screen and screen2 to the two screens they show
